preconditions: Exact independently bound PreparedJournal and PublicationPreflight, current native writer lock, explicit host authority, local same-filesystem rename and fsync support.
steps: Durably set committing; atomically replace targets in canonical path order and sync each acknowledgement before the next target; recompute the full live target root.
Inject errors at journal and target boundaries; preserve before images and active recovery blocker; never claim receipts, committed state or automatic rollback.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein Prozessabbruch oder interner Fehler während eines normativen Schreibbefehls DARF NICHT einen unvollständigen Zustand als regulär ladbaren Projektstand hinterlassen.
oracle.scope: Native C.2 publication steps 1-4 for supported artifact targets: exact final bytes/root or a blocked recovery state, never a successful mixed model. Full receipt finalization, specialized operations and universal command integration remain open.

open_items: Durable transaction/request receipts and committed finalization (5.n), full crash recovery and integration of all normative writer commands remain in later plan steps.
Local native cooperative Linux semantics; actual cross-version CI and underlying hardware determine observed support, not the existence of these tests.
